material_news_signals.headline: Rams head coach Sean McVay: WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to return for Rams Sunday vs. Eagles
material_news_signals.description: The Los Angeles Rams expect wide receiver Puka Nacua to play in Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles after missing the team's last two games with a hip/groin injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: the rams are ready to welcome back a major piece of their offense los angeles expects receiver puka nacua to play in sunday s game against the philadelphia eagles coach sean mcvay told reporters wednesday nacua was officially a limited participant in wednesday s practice a sign that he s nearing a return defensive tackle aaron donald meanwhile did not practice to back soreness per mcvay nacua has been battling a hip and groin injury related to his psoas since training camp inspiring concern he might be headed for surgery at some point in 2026 he managed to suit up for the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in melbourne australia in week 1 catching five passes for 74 yards but he s since been sidelined missing the rams last two games without nacua quarterback matthew stafford has leaned heavily on fellow veteran davante adams connecting with the three time all pro 15 times for 332 yards and two touchdowns in the last two weeks the production has been plentiful but without nacua it s also caused the rams to become a bit more predictable especially in the second half of the rams week 3 loss to denver underscoring their need for nacua s return it sounds as if that will happen sunday against an eagles team that is reeling from a lopsided loss to the chicago bears in which 38 year old quarterback case keenum threw for 247 yards and two touchdowns if nacua can fit back into the offense quickly stafford could be in line for an even more prolific afternoon

material_news_signals.headline: Colts vs. Commanders: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 4 London game
material_news_signals.description: Can Indianapolis star Jonathan Taylor break out of his early-season slump? Will Marcus Mariota lead Washington to a second straight win in relief of Jayden Daniels? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Colts-Commanders game in London.
material_news_signals.body_text: the european leg of the nfl s 2026 world tour kicks off this weekend in the league s most familiar foreign locale after stops in oceania and south america london is the setting for sunday morning football for the next three weeks starting with this week s colts commanders clash at tottenham hotspur stadium two of the nfl s older franchises indianapolis 1953 and washington 1932 are no strangers to the new reality of annual international football in fact both teams broke ground last season on the european continent the colts played in and won the nfl s first ever game played in berlin while the commanders participated in but lost the league s first game in spain played at madrid s bernabeu both indy and d c got off the schneid last week improving to 1 2 with surprising victories over 2025 playoff teams this sunday washington will look to break another ignominious streak winning its first international game in four tries the commanders are the only nfl franchise to play in at least three international games and not have a win 0 2 1 can the capital s club capitalize on its first win of the season with another in england or will jonathan taylor and co run over the competition overseas yet again three must know storylines 1 can taylor finally break out of early season slump jonathan taylor is as reggie jackson once coined himself the straw that stirs the drink he makes indy s offense go and has done so for the past six seasons this year he s tied for the league lead in rushing attempts through three games 66 but he s off to a career worst start in terms of efficiency taylor is averaging fewer than 4 rushing yards per attempt and has yet to record 100 ground yards in a game this season plus he s coming off the worst of his three efforts a 68 yard td less game in week 3 s slim win over houston standing in his way in week 4 a washington unit that has been surprisingly stout in run defense allowing just 246 yards through three weeks third in nfl at 3 8 yards per carry the commanders are tops in the league in run stuff percentage 25 and have allowed just five runs of 10 plus yards tied for third per next gen stats taylor was a horse in the colts international outing last season posting 244 rushing yards and 286 yards from scrimmage both international records per nfl research in indy s overtime victory over atlanta at olympiastadion with 78 rushing yards against washington taylor will be the all time leading rusher in international games in nfl history as daniel jones works his way back into form and the colts deal with health issues for wideouts alec pierce keenan allen and ashton dulin taylor needs to bring that horsepower again or indy won t be able to keep pace with jacksonville in the afc south 2 commanders sans starting qb in europe again washington is playing its second international game in as many years without its star quarterback under center after jayden daniels missed last year s madrid game with a dislocated elbow the nfl scheduled the commanders for a week 4 international bout surely the 2024 offensive rookie of the year would be healthy for that lone window slot nope daniels was ruled out for the second straight game on friday after dislocating the same left elbow in week 2 the commanders qb has foregone surgery and a stint on injured reserve and was limited in practices this week in london washington coach dan quinn said daniels return to practice was a big step that ll be little solace to the english fans who were eager to get a glimpse of the star signal caller in action on sunday lucky for washington it has an ace second stringer in fellow former no 2 pick marcus mariota the flyin hawaiian arrived in the united kingdom on a high this week after posting a throwback performance in the commanders week 3 upset of the reigning super bowl champion seahawks last sunday mariota enjoyed his first three td zero int 110 0 plus passer rating game since week 8 of 2022 and salted away the victory with a clutch read option run it was vintage stuff will it translate to week 4 against a league worst colts defense 417 3 total yards per game allowed albeit one that shut down houston last week or will a second consecutive game without daniels lead to another international defeat with mariota under center 3 can receivers take advantage of struggling dbs in a matchup featuring two down defenses it s paramount for each offense to identify areas of vulnerability to attack those soft spots lie in the secondaries of both ds meaning the offenses will aim to exploit advantages with their receivers the colts will be looking to new wr1 josh downs who took up the mantle left by the injured alec pierce and departed michael pittman downs has averaged a team high 2 4 yards per route on a 32 8 target rate in weeks 2 and 3 while the colts have mostly been without pierce and ranks 15th among qualified receivers in receiving expected points added 12 6 just below justin jefferson per next gen stats indy will hope to get him in positions against mike sainristil who has allowed a league high five touchdowns and a 142 4 passer rating when targeted through three weeks his defensive back mates jeremy reaves 154 6 rating 42 8 croe and quan martin 28 croe have fared no better opening up opportunities for keenan allen barring a groin issue keeping him out and tight end tyler warren meanwhile washington will look to exploit justin walley in the slot the colts primary nickelback has allowed 13 receptions on 15 targets for 213 yards and two tds in the slot the most yards allowed by any defender and 84 more than the next closest cb opponents have recorded a perfect 158 3 passer rating when targeting walley in those matchups per next gen stats that could spell a big day for the commanders top three receivers two time pro bowler terry mclaurin who s looking for his first 100 yard game in 2026 but is questionable with a balky hamstring rookie antonio williams who boasts a team high 27 2 croe and 8 7 receiving epa when targeted in the slot and veteran stefon diggs who has run a team high 44 routes out of the slot this season

material_news_signals.description: The Minnesota Vikings will be without their two-time All-Pro wide receiver on Sunday. Justin Jefferson (ankle) has been ruled out of the team's upcoming game against the Dolphins, head coach Kevin O'Connell said Friday.

material_news_signals.headline: Colts vs. Commanders: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 4 London game
material_news_signals.description: Can Indianapolis star Jonathan Taylor break out of his early-season slump? Will Marcus Mariota lead Washington to a second straight win in relief of Jayden Daniels? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Colts-Commanders game in London.
material_news_signals.body_text: the european leg of the nfl s 2026 world tour kicks off this weekend in the league s most familiar foreign locale after stops in oceania and south america london is the setting for sunday morning football for the next three weeks starting with this week s colts commanders clash at tottenham hotspur stadium two of the nfl s older franchises indianapolis 1953 and washington 1932 are no strangers to the new reality of annual international football in fact both teams broke ground last season on the european continent the colts played in and won the nfl s first ever game played in berlin while the commanders participated in but lost the league s first game in spain played at madrid s bernabeu both indy and d c got off the schneid last week improving to 1 2 with surprising victories over 2025 playoff teams this sunday washington will look to break another ignominious streak winning its first international game in four tries the commanders are the only nfl franchise to play in at least three international games and not have a win 0 2 1 can the capital s club capitalize on its first win of the season with another in england or will jonathan taylor and co run over the competition overseas yet again three must know storylines 1 can taylor finally break out of early season slump jonathan taylor is as reggie jackson once coined himself the straw that stirs the drink he makes indy s offense go and has done so for the past six seasons this year he s tied for the league lead in rushing attempts through three games 66 but he s off to a career worst start in terms of efficiency taylor is averaging fewer than 4 rushing yards per attempt and has yet to record 100 ground yards in a game this season plus he s coming off the worst of his three efforts a 68 yard td less game in week 3 s slim win over houston standing in his way in week 4 a washington unit that has been surprisingly stout in run defense allowing just 246 yards through three weeks third in nfl at 3 8 yards per carry the commanders are tops in the league in run stuff percentage 25 and have allowed just five runs of 10 plus yards tied for third per next gen stats taylor was a horse in the colts international outing last season posting 244 rushing yards and 286 yards from scrimmage both international records per nfl research in indy s overtime victory over atlanta at olympiastadion with 78 rushing yards against washington taylor will be the all time leading rusher in international games in nfl history as daniel jones works his way back into form and the colts deal with health issues for wideouts alec pierce keenan allen and ashton dulin taylor needs to bring that horsepower again or indy won t be able to keep pace with jacksonville in the afc south 2 commanders sans starting qb in europe again washington is playing its second international game in as many years without its star quarterback under center after jayden daniels missed last year s madrid game with a dislocated elbow the nfl scheduled the commanders for a week 4 international bout surely the 2024 offensive rookie of the year would be healthy for that lone window slot nope daniels was ruled out for the second straight game on friday after dislocating the same left elbow in week 2 the commanders qb has foregone surgery and a stint on injured reserve and was limited in practices this week in london washington coach dan quinn said daniels return to practice was a big step that ll be little solace to the english fans who were eager to get a glimpse of the star signal caller in action on sunday lucky for washington it has an ace second stringer in fellow former no 2 pick marcus mariota the flyin hawaiian arrived in the united kingdom on a high this week after posting a throwback performance in the commanders week 3 upset of the reigning super bowl champion seahawks last sunday mariota enjoyed his first three td zero int 110 0 plus passer rating game since week 8 of 2022 and salted away the victory with a clutch read option run it was vintage stuff will it translate to week 4 against a league worst colts defense 417 3 total yards per game allowed albeit one that shut down houston last week or will a second consecutive game without daniels lead to another international defeat with mariota under center 3 can receivers take advantage of struggling dbs in a matchup featuring two down defenses it s paramount for each offense to identify areas of vulnerability to attack those soft spots lie in the secondaries of both ds meaning the offenses will aim to exploit advantages with their receivers the colts will be looking to new wr1 josh downs who took up the mantle left by the injured alec pierce and departed michael pittman downs has averaged a team high 2 4 yards per route on a 32 8 target rate in weeks 2 and 3 while the colts have mostly been without pierce and ranks 15th among qualified receivers in receiving expected points added 12 6 just below justin jefferson per next gen stats indy will hope to get him in positions against mike sainristil who has allowed a league high five touchdowns and a 142 4 passer rating when targeted through three weeks his defensive back mates jeremy reaves 154 6 rating 42 8 croe and quan martin 28 croe have fared no better opening up opportunities for keenan allen barring a groin issue keeping him out and tight end tyler warren meanwhile washington will look to exploit justin walley in the slot the colts primary nickelback has allowed 13 receptions on 15 targets for 213 yards and two tds in the slot the most yards allowed by any defender and 84 more than the next closest cb opponents have recorded a perfect 158 3 passer rating when targeting walley in those matchups per next gen stats that could spell a big day for the commanders top three receivers two time pro bowler terry mclaurin who s looking for his first 100 yard game in 2026 but is questionable with a balky hamstring rookie antonio williams who boasts a team high 27 2 croe and 8 7 receiving epa when targeted in the slot and veteran stefon diggs who has run a team high 44 routes out of the slot this season

material_news_signals.headline: Patrick Mahomes eager to face Maxx Crosby after odd offseason: Chiefs-Raiders is 'pure football'
material_news_signals.description: Patrick Mahomes is back from his season-ending ACL injury and playing excellently, and edge rusher Maxx Crosby is out to ruin Mahomes' day -- and add a little trash talk on top.
material_news_signals.body_text: it s been a long time since the raiders and chiefs met with identically undefeated records that s what s on deck for sunday though with 3 0 las vegas hosting 3 0 kansas city at allegiant stadium it s a matchup that is as surprising on paper as it is anticipated by both parties the contest includes two stars who will compete against each other plenty quarterback patrick mahomes is back from his season ending acl injury and playing excellently and edge rusher maxx crosby is out to ruin mahomes day and add a little trash talk on top i m here that s all i m going to have for now mahomes said wednesday when asked if he and crosby have had memorable exchanges in previous meetings i think it s just being competitors it s almost like whenever you re young and you re competing with one of your friends man you want to win because you kind of have those bragging rights and you kind of go into the offseason and if you see the guy you can kind of give him a little something here and there it s something about that it s just what the pure football is is having the best competitors compete against each other and that s what i think you really get whenever you go out there and it s raiders versus chiefs mahomes and crosby are each coming off unusually eventful offseasons for a few days in march crosby was destined to move to baltimore and become a raven baltimore s cold feet nixed that deal sending crosby back to the afc west to continue harassing mahomes the superstar quarterback meanwhile was in the midst of a long recovery from knee surgery necessitated by a december injury he actually texted me right when i got cleared to play and just kind of said hey we re both back and for me i was just kind of like let s show the world who we are mahomes said of his interaction with crosby and so i think that s just the competitors in this league there is a rivalry when we step on that field we re going to go at it that s just kind of what it is and we both know that but at the end of the day man you want the great competitors the great players in this league because it makes the league better and it makes when you go out there and do get the win even better both have had points to prove early in the 2026 season and both are riding high after three straight victories to begin the campaign they re playing great football you can see it on tape mahomes said of the raiders that 3 0 record s real they ve been playing great the entire season and so for us it s another step another challenge that we have to go up there and match by the time the clock strikes zero sunday one will no longer be perfect while the other will have a new feather in their well worn rivalry cap i just know when i step on that football field i m going to need my best because he s going to bring his best mahomes said and i think that s when you get the best games out there
